text:
Alex Kim: Heads up — runtime/kb/onboarding/runbook.md has a broken curl link in the 'deploy' snippet. I hit a 404 in local preview, curious who owns this doc.
Sara Patel: @Alex Kim filing this under onboarding docs — I think Jordan or the onboarding squad last touched it. docbot also flagged something this morning.
Jordan Lee: I took a quick peek — the snippet calls /api/v1/deploy but we migrated to /api/v2/deploy in the runtime rename. Easy fix but probably should use the canonical shortlink to avoid future drift.
Priya Nair: I can open a PR for this in a few mins. Quick plan: replace the path and add a frontmatter note about endpoint versioning.
Priya Nair: Commands I'll run:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/runbook-deploy-link
sed -i 's#/api/v1/deploy#/api/v2/deploy#g' runtime/kb/onboarding/runbook.md
git add runtime/kb/onboarding/runbook.md && git commit -m "docs: fix deploy snippet path and add note"
```
Alex Kim: SGTM. @Priya Nair can you also add a one-line comment in the snippet that the example is for the hosted API (so folks don't copy straight to private envs)?
Priya Nair: yep will add that and mark the PR WIP, assigning @Jordan Lee for review. I'll ping #docs-review once it's ready.
docbot: link-monitor detected 1 broken link (runtime/kb/onboarding/runbook.md: line 42) — opened issue #1234.
Sara Patel: Nice, thanks. Once PR is up i'll route it to handbook owners for a backport to the v1-runbooks branch if needed. :thumbsup:
